note: a place of kind lite: landmarks (rows in the shards, one a part: features/<code>.json; drawn with their own id: _FEATURE_ID_0 = row at the leaves, glb extras.blocks.boxes.f = row where a coarse level draws one as a box) plus every other building as its own box at the leaves (no id, no outline: glb extras.blocks.compact, layout cwplans-boxes-1) and the merged mass at the coarse levels (one box a square, no ids); ground_m = the globe's ground (world-base heights, metres above the geoid); names.json: the named landmarks for search

lite.tile_extras: glb extras.blocks: classes (labels by class index), height_sources (labels), boxes (the landmark boxes, then the compact boxes as the reader appends them: c class index, h height in decimetres, s height-source index, f the features.json row of a landmark drawn as a box, -1 otherwise), outlines (none in a lite set), named (the features.json rows drawn as outlines, _FEATURE_ID_0), mass_buildings (the buildings the merged squares stand for), compact (the compact boxes: compact)

compact.where: glb extras.blocks.compact: bufferView (8 bytes a box), grid.bufferView (n x n int16)
compact.box: int16 east, int16 north (x q m, in the tile frame), uint8 area code, uint8 height code, uint8 angle code, uint8 flags; little-endian
compact.height_code: code <= 200: code / 4 m; else 50 + (code - 200) x 5 m
compact.angle_code: angle of the long side = code x 180 / 256 degrees, from east toward north
compact.flags: bits 0-3 aspect k (long / short = 2^(k / 3)), bit 4 footprint class (0 OpenStreetMap, 1 Microsoft), bits 5-7 height source (height_sources)
compact.sides: long = sqrt(area x aspect), short = sqrt(area / aspect)
compact.ground: grid of n x n int16 decimetres of the tile frame's up over east e0 + i de, north n0 + j dn (rows from the south), bilinear; a box stands from ground - drop_m to ground + height

kinds.buildings: one box a building (leaves; class from the flags)
kinds.squares: one box a square of merged buildings (coarse levels until place-lite-tiles 5 and place-blocks 6; aspect 1, turned to the grain of its buildings, flags 0)
kinds.blocks: far forms (coarse levels since place-lite-tiles 5 and place-blocks 6, issue #13): one box a building or a street block of adjacent buildings at its true position, kept where it is big enough to see from that level; class and height source of its largest building

far.rule: coarse levels draw real buildings at their true positions, no squares: the buildings of each leaf cell whose oriented boxes come within gap_m of each other and whose heights differ by at most max(h_abs_m, h_rel x the taller) are one street block (one oriented box at their grain, its footprint the sum of theirs, its height their area-weighted mean; cut at the area median while they fill less than fill_min of it); a level draws the blocks whose seen size sqrt(area) x max(sqrt(area), height) is at least min_m2 of the level (about one device pixel squared at the far end of its range on a phone); the rest are counted (far_left_out), not drawn at that level
